note: Dataset source: LAV-DF (Cai et al., 2022), test split, sampled with the frozen rule in scripts/build_lavdf_eval_set.py. NOT FakeAVCeleb. Real generators: SV2TTS voice cloning and Wav2Lip lip-sync on VoxCeleb2 speakers.. Never report this as a FakeAVCeleb result unless the manifest's own source field says so.
audio_weighting_source: measured, balanced accuracy at P(fake) >= 0.5 on the full ASVspoof 2019 LA eval partition (plain accuracy there is 0.9765, but the set is 90% spoof, so plain accuracy overstates the branch)
video_weighting_source: cross-validated: pooled out-of-fold clip accuracy over all 400 videos, 5 identity-grouped folds (results/cv/cv5_xcep_mm/cv_summary.json), 95% interval 79.2% to 86.2%. Chosen over the 96.2% figure from the 44-video test split because the PPR's weighting basis (Large, Lines and Bagnall, 2019) is cross-validated accuracy and the small split is optimistic.
threshold_T_source: tuned on the shipped model (Xception multi-method, seed 44) against the self-built fallback evaluation set, maximising F1 on identifying genuine single-modality manipulation (79 clips; F1 0.907, precision 0.848, recall 0.975); see results/fallback_eval_shipped/threshold_tuning.json
